Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> looks dejected after failing the quest.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 依頼に失敗した<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、しょんぼりしている。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> est abattu(e) après l'échec de la quête.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Nachdem <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> bei der Quest gescheitert ist, ist er/sie niedergeschlagen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Después de fallar la misión, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se veía desanimada.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ficou desanimado(a) após falhar na missão.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดูห่อเหี่ยวหลังจากภารกิจล้มเหลว
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> terlihat kecewa setelah gagal dalam misi.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> trông ủ rũ sau khi thất bại trong nhiệm vụ.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: खोज में विफल होने के बाद <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> उदास दिख रहा है।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: Don't let it get you down. Cheer up!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 落ち込まないで元気を出そう。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_CHN: 别垂头丧气，打起精神来吧。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_TWN: 別垂頭喪氣，打起精神來吧。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Ne te laisse pas abattre. Courage !
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Lass dich nicht unterkriegen. Kopf hoch!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: อย่าเพิ่งท้อแท้สิ! ให้กำลังใจตัวเองหน่อย!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Đừng nản lòng. Vui lên nào!

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: Here, drink this and feel better.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: これを飲んで元気を出して。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ดื่มนี่แล้วสู้ๆ
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Uống cái này và cố lên.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: लो, इसे पियो और बेहतर महसूस करो।

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 그새 실패의 아쉬움을 털어냈는지 시원한 미소를 지었다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> quickly shook off her disappointment and smiled brightly.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>はその間に失敗の悔しさを振り払ったのか、爽やかな微笑みを浮かべた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎已将失败的懊恼抛诸脑后，露出了爽朗的笑容。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎已將失敗的懊惱拋諸腦後，露出了爽朗的笑容。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a rapidement secoué sa déception et a souri à pleines dents.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> schüttelte ihre/seine Enttäuschung schnell ab und lächelte strahlend.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> sonrió con alivio, como si ya hubiera superado la decepción del fracaso.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> sorriu abertamente, como se já tivesse superado o pesar do fracasso.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดูเหมือนจะลืมความผิดหวังจากความล้มเหลวไปแล้ว ยิ้มกว้างอย่างสดใส
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tersenyum lega, seolah sudah melupakan kekecewaan atas kegagalannya.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã gạt bỏ sự tiếc nuối vì thất bại, nở một nụ cười sảng khoái.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने अपनी निराशा को जल्दी से दूर किया और चमकती हुई मुस्कान दी।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>'s face showed a hint of disappointment.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>の顔には悔しさがにじんでいる。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Le visage de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> semblait empli de déception.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: El rostro de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> estaba lleno de decepción.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ใบหน้าของ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> เต็มไปด้วยความผิดหวัง
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Khuôn mặt của <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tràn đầy vẻ thất vọng.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> के चेहरे पर निराशा भरी दिख रही है।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> brightened up after receiving the potion.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、ポーションを受け取って喜んだ。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a retrouvé le sourire après avoir reçu la potion.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hellte sich auf, nachdem er/sie den Trank erhalten hatte.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se alegró de recibir la poción.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดูสดใสขึ้นหลังจากได้รับยา
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> nhận được bình thuốc và vui mừng.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: पोशन मिलने के बाद <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> खुश हो गया।
